title: go-dicom show --json, schemaVersion 1
description: What `go-dicom show --json <file>` prints: a DICOM file and where each part of it sits. Readers ignore properties this schema does not name; a property added later does not change schemaVersion. See show-json.md.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this document format.

file.description: The path as it was given on the command line.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

preamble.description: True for a Part 10 file, with a 128-byte preamble, the DICM prefix and a file meta group. False for a bare data set.

regions.description: The parts of the file in order: preamble, prefix and fileMeta for a Part 10 file, then dataSet.

offsetsRelativeTo.description: What every offset in fileMeta and dataSet counts from: the start of the file, or, for a deflated data set, the start of the data set after it was inflated.

fileMeta.description: The elements of the file meta group, in file order. Empty for a bare data set.

dataSet.description: The elements of the data set, in file order.

warnings.description: What the reader noticed about the file and recovered from.

tag.description: A tag as (gggg,eeee), in upper-case hexadecimal.

endOffset.description: The offset of the first byte after the region.

uid.description: The Transfer Syntax UID of the file meta group; empty when the file has none.

delimiter.description: An Item Delimitation Item or Sequence Delimitation Item: a tag and a length of zero, 8 bytes.

keyword.description: The dictionary keyword; empty for a tag the dictionary does not know.

name.description: The dictionary name; empty for a tag the dictionary does not know.

vr.description: The VR the element is read as; empty when neither the file nor the dictionary gives one.

vm.description: How many values the element holds.

value.description: The value as text, with a backslash between multiple values. Absent for a sequence and for binary values, which are given by their position alone.

vrOffset.description: Where the two VR bytes are; null in an implicit VR data set.

lengthSize.description: How many bytes the length field takes.

valueLength.description: The bytes from valueOffset to the end of the content. A delimiter that closes the value is not part of it.

endOffset.description: The offset of the first byte after the element, delimiter included.

items.description: The items of a sequence. Absent when the sequence has none.

fragments.description: The items of encapsulated Pixel Data: the offset table first, then the fragments.
